results.title: poppy.json is served over HTTPS at the well-known path
results.quote: A Company MUST publish its poppy.json document at https://{domain}/.well-known/poppy.json over HTTPS

results.title: Every redirect of the well-known URL is to an HTTPS URL
results.quote: every redirect MUST be to an HTTPS URL

results.title: poppy.json is a JSON object
results.quote: The JSON document a Company publishes at /.well-known/poppy.json

results.title: poppy.json fields have the forms section 3.1 describes
results.quote: to tell Personal Agents how to start Sessions and sign in, and which APIs and Company Agent it offers

results.title: protocol_version is the version this validator checks
results.quote: a Personal Agent MUST NOT use a document whose major.minor version it doesn't support.

results.title: organization.domain is the host that serves poppy.json, after redirects
results.quote: domain MUST be the host that serves the document, after any redirects. Domains are compared ignoring case, with no other normalization.

results.title: auth is present when agent, apis, feedback, or web.browser_session_endpoint is
results.quote: Sessions need auth, so a Company without it can only be browsed as an ordinary website (section 5).

results.title: poppy.json lists at least one of agent, apis, or web
results.quote: One of agent, apis, or web

results.title: Each API's type is openapi or mcp
results.quote: Each API's type MUST be one of these

results.title: The issuer publishes OAuth Authorization Server Metadata
results.quote: The issuer MUST publish OAuth Authorization Server Metadata (RFC 8414)

results.title: The metadata has the fields section 3.2 requires, in the right forms
results.quote: The Personal Agent uses these fields of the metadata

results.title: The metadata's issuer exactly matches auth.issuer
results.quote: MUST check that its issuer exactly matches auth.issuer

results.title: poppy_domains includes organization.domain
results.quote: poppy_domains in it MUST list every domain whose poppy.json names the issuer

results.title: The metadata has a token_endpoint
results.quote: token_endpoint issues Session and Account Tokens (4.2, 4.8). Required.

results.title: The metadata has a revocation_endpoint
results.quote: revocation_endpoint revokes Account Tokens (4.9). Required.

results.title: dpop_signing_alg_values_supported, if present, includes ES256
results.quote: the list MUST then include ES256.

results.title: The metadata has an authorization_endpoint when auth.direct is present
results.quote: authorization_endpoint starts Direct Sign-In (4.5). Required if auth.direct is present.

results.title: The metadata has a device_authorization_endpoint when auth.device is present
results.quote: device_authorization_endpoint starts Device Sign-In (4.6). Required if auth.device is present.

results.title: Token endpoint starts a Session with the JWT bearer grant
results.quote: To start a Session, the Personal Agent requests a Session Token from the Company's token_endpoint with the JWT bearer grant (RFC 7523).

results.title: Session response has the fields section 4.2 lists
results.quote: Personal Agents MUST NOT depend on their contents; everything they need is in the response.

results.title: A Session Token requested with a DPoP Proof has token_type DPoP
results.quote: token_type is DPoP, or Bearer for a token for an MCP server that doesn't support DPoP (4.3).

results.title: expires_in is greater than 0
results.quote: The Company chooses the value, and it MUST be greater than 0.

results.title: Session Tokens last hours, not days
results.quote: Session Tokens SHOULD last hours, not days.

results.title: A new Session is signed out, with no scopes
results.quote: scope is a space-separated string of the account scopes granted (4.4). A signed-out token has none.

results.title: Token responses send Cache-Control: no-store
results.quote: Send Cache-Control: no-store on every response that carries a token or code.

results.title: Renewing with session_id returns a token for the same Session
results.quote: The Company checks that the Session belongs to the same client_id and User ID as the assertion, and returns a new signed-out Session Token for it.

results.title: An unknown session_id returns invalid_session
results.quote: If it has ended, the Company returns invalid_session, and the Personal Agent starts a new Session.

results.title: Token endpoint rejects a reused Session assertion jti
results.quote: The Company MUST reject a jti it has already seen from the same client_id until the assertion expires, so a copied assertion can't be used again.

results.title: Token endpoint rejects a client assertion whose aud is the token endpoint URL
results.quote: Companies MUST reject a client assertion with any other aud, compared character for character, including their token endpoint URL.

results.title: Token endpoint rejects a client assertion signed by a key not in jwks_uri
results.quote: The Company verifies both assertions against the Personal Agent's jwks_uri

results.title: Token endpoint rejects a Session assertion signed by a key not in jwks_uri
results.quote: The Company verifies both assertions against the Personal Agent's jwks_uri

results.title: Token endpoint rejects a browser assertion as a Session assertion
results.quote: A Session assertion isn't accepted here, and a browser assertion isn't accepted at the token endpoint.

results.title: DPoP nonces, if required, are issued as RFC 9449 describes
results.quote: A Company MAY require proofs to include a nonce it issued, as RFC 9449 describes, so proofs can't be made in advance.
results.reason: The token endpoint didn't ask for a DPoP nonce (nonces are optional).

results.title: Token endpoint rejects a reused DPoP proof
results.quote: At the token endpoint, the Company MUST reject a proof whose jti it has already accepted within the acceptance window

results.title: Token endpoint rejects a DPoP proof made for a different URL
results.quote: htm and htu match the request.

results.title: A DPoP Session Token with a valid proof is accepted
results.quote: API calls and conversations MUST carry the Session Token in the Authorization header with the DPoP scheme, together with a DPoP Proof

results.title: A request without a DPoP proof is rejected with 401 and WWW-Authenticate: DPoP
results.quote: APIs and conversation endpoints return HTTP 401 with the error in the WWW-Authenticate: DPoP header

results.title: A DPoP Session Token sent with the Bearer scheme is rejected
results.quote: Everywhere else, Companies MUST require DPoP, and MUST reject a DPoP Session Token sent with the Bearer scheme (RFC 9449 §7.1).

results.title: A proof whose ath doesn't match the token is rejected
results.quote: On requests with a Session Token, the key is the one the token is bound to, and ath matches the token.

results.title: A proof signed by a key the token isn't bound to is rejected
results.quote: On requests with a Session Token, the key is the one the token is bound to, and ath matches the token.

results.title: A proof made for a different URL is rejected
results.quote: htm and htu match the request.

results.title: A Session Token in the URL query is not accepted
results.quote: Personal Agents MUST NOT send tokens in a URL, and Companies MUST NOT accept them from one.

results.title: The OpenAPI description loads
results.quote: An OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 description of the API.

results.title: The OpenAPI description declares version 3.0 or 3.1
results.quote: An OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1 description of the API.

results.title: The MCP server publishes protected resource metadata
results.quote: MCP clients find where to get a token from the server's protected resource metadata (RFC 9728)

results.title: The protected resource metadata's authorization_servers includes auth.issuer
results.quote: its authorization_servers MUST include auth.issuer

results.title: The MCP server rejects a request without a token and points to its metadata
results.quote: MCP clients find where to get a token from the server's protected resource metadata (RFC 9728)

results.title: Token endpoint issues a Bearer Session Token for an MCP server without DPoP, with or without a proof
results.quote: For an MCP server that doesn't support DPoP, the Company issues a Bearer Session Token, even if the request has a proof, and never a DPoP one.

results.title: The MCP server accepts a Bearer Session Token issued for it
results.quote: A listed MCP server MUST accept Session Tokens as its access tokens and enforce their scopes.

results.title: The MCP server rejects the general DPoP Session Token
results.quote: It MUST accept only tokens issued for its url (4.3).

results.title: Token endpoint issues a DPoP Session Token for an MCP server that supports DPoP
results.quote: For an MCP server that supports DPoP, the Company issues a DPoP Session Token, which the Personal Agent uses with proofs, as at any other API.

results.title: Token endpoint refuses a Bearer Session Token for an MCP server that supports DPoP
results.quote: The Company MUST NOT issue a Personal Agent a Bearer Session Token for an MCP server that supports DPoP, so a request without a proof gets invalid_dpop_proof.

results.title: The MCP server accepts a DPoP Session Token issued for it
results.quote: A listed MCP server MUST accept Session Tokens as its access tokens and enforce their scopes.

results.title: The MCP server rejects a Bearer token issued for another resource
results.quote: It MUST accept only tokens issued for its url (4.3).

results.title: A Bearer token for the MCP server is rejected outside MCP
results.quote: Companies MUST accept a Bearer Session Token only at the MCP server whose url equals its resource, and MUST reject it at every other endpoint, including other paths on the same host.

results.title: Starting a conversation returns 201 with conversation_id, status, and responder
results.quote: The Company returns the new conversation's ID

results.title: Retrying the first message returns the same conversation
results.quote: If the Company has already accepted a message with that ID and the same content, it returns the original response and doesn't add the message again.

results.title: Reusing a message ID with different content returns message_id_conflict
results.quote: If the content is different, the Company returns message_id_conflict.

results.title: A later message returns 202 with status and responder
results.quote: Later messages go to the conversation's messages URL, which returns HTTP 202 with the same fields

results.title: A message without text, data, or context returns invalid_request
results.quote: A message MUST have at least one of text, data, or context.

results.title: A message ID with characters not allowed returns invalid_request
results.quote: Conversation IDs, message IDs, and event IDs are strings of 1 to 256 characters from the URL-safe base64 alphabet

results.title: Reading events returns conversation_id, events, cursor, has_more, status, and responder
results.quote: Every successful read MUST include conversation_id, events, cursor, has_more, status, and responder, with events empty when there are none.

results.title: Events have the fields section 7.5 describes
results.quote: Every event has an id, a type, and a created_at time

results.title: The first message is recorded as an event with role user
results.quote: a message from either side, as it was sent, with role set by the Company to user or company for the side it came from

results.title: A retried message is recorded only once
results.quote: If the Company has already accepted a message with that ID and the same content, it returns the original response and doesn't add the message again.

results.title: A read with wait=1 returns within about a second when there's nothing new
results.quote: The Company holds the request for up to wait seconds until there is an event to return.

results.title: A wait that isn't a whole number returns invalid_request
results.quote: a wait that isn't a whole number of seconds

results.title: An unknown cursor returns invalid_cursor
results.quote: The cursor is unknown or doesn't belong to this conversation.

results.title: An unknown Conversation ID returns conversation_not_found
results.quote: The Conversation ID is unknown or belongs to a different Personal Agent, User, or account (7.2).

results.title: Closing returns 200 with status closed
results.quote: returns HTTP 200 with status and responder

results.title: Closing adds a state event with status closed
results.quote: The Company adds a state event with status: "closed"

results.title: Closing again returns 200 and adds no event
results.quote: Closing a conversation that is already closed returns the same response and adds no event.

results.title: A message to a closed conversation returns conversation_closed
results.quote: A message or handoff was sent to a closed conversation.

results.title: A handoff request to a closed conversation returns conversation_closed
results.quote: A message or handoff was sent to a closed conversation.
